info.name: Connectly API v1
info.description: Importable Postman collection for the Connectly API. Requests are grouped by workflow from account creation through posts, comments, social actions, and admin operations. Set the collection variables before running requests that depend on existing users or admin credentials.

item.name: User Account Flow
item.description: Start here for a normal user: register, verify, login, inspect the profile, manage settings, reset password, and handle account deletion or reactivation.

request.description: Creates a user account and sends an email verification link. If the response includes an id or verification token, they are saved to collection variables.
Verifies a newly registered user with the token from email or the registration response.
Alternative registration confirmation endpoint backed by the verification token table.
Authenticates a user and saves the JWT as `userToken`.

exec: pm.test('User login returns a token', function () { pm.expect(json.token).to.be.a('string'); });

Starts a password reset flow using an emailed one-time passcode.
Completes a password reset using either a reset token or OTP.
Soft-deletes the authenticated user and schedules permanent deletion.
Reactivates a deleted account using the reactivation token.

item.name: User Content Flow
item.description: Create and manage posts, comments, likes, and feeds as a normal authenticated user.

item.name: Admin Flow
item.description: Admin-focused requests. There is no admin creation API, so set `adminEmail` and `adminPassword` to an existing admin account.

request.description: Authenticates an existing admin and saves the JWT as `adminToken`.
